objectives: durable project continuity independent of chat sessions
rapid agent/workflow failure detection and recovery
persistent lessons so solved failures are not rediscovered from zero
cloud continuity when the local laptop is offline

reconstruct_from: exact current pull requests and CI evidence
Google Drive backup only after repository evidence

required_before_use: poisoned stale replay and substitution rejection

Exact final-head full required CI is not yet proven.

memory_pr_validation.note: merge only after exact final head CI is green, mergeable=true and review evidence is clean

207.remaining_gate: full exact-final-head required CI, mergeability recalculation, ADR alignment, zero unresolved review threads, implementation coupling and rollback/recovery replay

204.lesson: registry schema evolution without consumer validator evolution fails closed and must not be merged independently

202.remaining_gate: replay from current main after registry authority is settled, then implementation-registry coupling, bypass coverage, rollback/recovery replay and clean final-head evidence

fail_closed_verification.release_gate: rejects missing/tampered/malformed manifest, SBOM and provenance; production signature verification blocks without approved identity policy
fail_closed_verification.recovery_gate: rejects non-identical outputs, unsafe rollback evidence and pre-authorized rollback records

offline_semantics.internet_outage: local runtime may continue in reduced mode; cloud synchronization resumes after connectivity returns
offline_semantics.laptop_powered_off: local collectors halt; remote cloud continuity is a separate target and must not be conflated with an internet outage

recovery_lessons: caller-controlled finite limits are not safe bounds unless an implementation-owned maximum is enforced before side effects
stale or conflicted implementation PRs should be replayed onto exact current main only after overlap is checked
configured push triggers are not proof of an exact-SHA successful run
exact-head PR CI and exact-main release evidence are distinct claims
Drive presence alone is not recovery proof
cryptographic binding proves only claims included in the bound payload; omitted timeframe/endpoint/category/finality semantics remain fail-closed
policy-only slices may define a reviewable contract without granting implementation or downstream authority
after policy or main advances, stale implementation branches should be replayed from exact current main rather than inheriting old CI authority
schema or registry evolution must update fail-closed validators and tests in lockstep; registry-only changes that the validator cannot interpret must remain unmerged
retargeting a stacked fix to current main is safer than merging a known-red base PR when the combined objective is coherent and current-main overlap is absent
